definitions.gloss: branch office; local office; field office; agency
definitions.explanation: A smaller satellite office of a larger organization, typically a government agency or company, set up in a different location to provide services closer to the local population.

examples.japanese: ⟦{市役所|しやくしょ}→市役所：03067_shiyakusho⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{出張所|しゅっちょうじょ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To complete paperwork at the city hall branch office.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地区|ちく}→地区：03463_chiku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{郵便局|ゆうびんきょく}→郵便局：00579_yuubinkyoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{出張所|しゅっちょうじょ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a post office branch in this district.

examples.japanese: ⟦{住民票|じゅうみんひょう}→住民票：09628_juuminhyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{最寄|もよ}り→最寄り：28821_moyori⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{出張所|しゅっちょうじょ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{取得|しゅとく}→取得：11947_shutoku⟧⟦できます→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: Residence certificates can also be obtained at the nearest branch office.

notes:
Combines ⟦{出張|しゅっちょう}→出張：01094_shucchou⟧ (dispatching) + {所|じょ} (place). Most commonly refers to local government satellite offices that handle routine administrative services closer to residents.

COMMON SERVICES:
- ⟦{住民票|じゅうみんひょう}→住民票：09628_juuminhyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{発行|はっこう}→発行：03693_hakkou⟧: issuing residence certificates
- ⟦{戸籍|こせき}{謄本|とうほん}→戸籍謄本：10286_kosekitouhon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{取得|しゅとく}→取得：11947_shutoku⟧: obtaining family register copies
- ⟦{届出|とどけで}→届出：07555_todokede⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{受付|うけつけ}→受付：01325_uketsuke⟧: accepting notifications and applications

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{市役所|しやくしょ}→市役所：03067_shiyakusho⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{出張所|しゅっちょうじょ}: city hall branch office
- ⟦{最寄|もよ}り→最寄り：28821_moyori⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{出張所|しゅっちょうじょ}: nearest branch office
- {出張所|しゅっちょうじょ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to complete procedures at a branch office

RELATED WORDS:
- {支所|ししょ}: sub-office (similar to {出張所|しゅっちょうじょ}, sometimes used interchangeably)
- ⟦{支店|してん}→支店：03185_shiten⟧: branch (for private companies and banks)
- {本庁|ほんちょう}: main office of a government body
- ⟦{出張|しゅっちょう}→出張：01094_shucchou⟧: business trip (the base word, with a different meaning)
